en: A beige postcard from the Museum of Physical Education and Sports in Budapest. The upper left text is bilingual (Hungarian and English). There is a small sepia image of an athlete in a rowing boat. At the upper right is a green triangular Hungarian postage stamp depicting a swimmer, marked 'MAGYAR POSTA' and 'BELGRÁD 1973', with a value of 1.20 Ft. Over the stamp is a round cancellation mark featuring a rowing image and 'TESTNEVELÉSI ÉS SPORTMÚZEUM' and 'BUDAPEST'. At the bottom left is bilingual text announcing an exposition of sports medals in 1987. The right side has blank lines for address.
